mechanism: Both agents have CNS depressant properties; valerian may inhibit CYP2C9 and CYP3A4, potentially increasing primidone metabolism unpredictably, while additive sedation and impaired cognition may occur.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation, dizziness, and impaired coordination; counsel patient to avoid abrupt discontinuation of either agent and consider alternative anxiolytics if CNS depression becomes problematic.
